user.title: Climate device
user.description: Pick the air conditioner you want to control with profiles.

data_description.name: Used for the device and the entity names, e.g. "Living room".
data_description.climate_entity: Supported modes, temperature range and step width are read from this entity.

reconfigure.title: Climate entity
reconfigure.description: Point this device at a different climate entity. Profiles, values and the entities of this device stay as they are.

data_description.climate_entity: Profiles are not adapted to the new device. Clear values it cannot take - a fan mode on a thermostat without a fan - or the profile never matches.

error.entity_not_found: This entity does not exist (any more).

abort.already_configured: This climate entity is already configured.

values.title: Manage values
values.description: One row per value, with the entity behind it. Drag a row to move it, the pencil edits it, the bin removes it - profiles keep what they stored for a deleted value, it is simply skipped from then on. To point a value at a different entity, edit the row: adding it anew would create a new value and lose it from every profile.

data_description.selected: Everything on the same device that could carry a value, minus what you already have. They are added at the end of the list.
data_description.order: Decides which value wins when two contradict each other on your device - a silent mode that sets its own fan speed, for example. The mode always goes first; anything you leave out keeps its place at the end.

profiles.title: Manage profiles
profiles.description: One row per profile, with everything it is: name, colour, icon, how it becomes active, what a change by hand does, and the values it sets. The order of the rows is the order they are matched and shown in. Clear a value to remove it from the profile - an empty field means the profile does not touch it.

data_description.custom_profile_name: Shown whenever the current state matches none of your profiles. It has no values of its own.

automatic.title: Automatic mode
automatic.description: Automatic mode applies the profile a sensor of yours names. Its state has to be a profile's name or id - which profile that is, a template, a schedule or an automation decides, not this integration. While automatic mode is on, profiles cannot be chosen by hand. It is switched on and off with the device's "Automatic mode" switch, which exists only while a sensor is set here.

data_description.profile_sensor: Leave empty to remove automatic mode. A state that names no profile, or no state at all, writes nothing - the device keeps what it has until the sensor names a profile again.

error.invalid_profile: This profile could not be saved. Please check name and values.
error.unsupported_domain: This kind of entity has no single value to compare, so it cannot be used.
error.entity_not_found: This entity does not exist (any more).
error.name_taken: Another profile is already called "{name}", or it is the name of the custom profile. Profile names have to be unique.

apply_profile.name: Apply profile
apply_profile.description: Applies a stored profile. Only the values the profile defines are written; everything else keeps its current value.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name or id of the profile.

set_value.name: Set value
set_value.description: Writes individual values and re-evaluates which profile that state corresponds to.

hvac_mode.name: Mode
hvac_mode.description: One of the modes the device supports.

swing_mode.name: Swing mode
swing_mode.description: One of the swing modes the device supports.

fan_mode.name: Fan mode
fan_mode.description: One of the fan modes the device supports.

capture_profile.name: Capture into profile
capture_profile.description: Writes the current state into a stored profile. Values the profile already defines are updated; a value you changed by hand is added.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name or id of the profile to write into.

values.name: Values
values.description: Capture only these values instead of deciding automatically.

save_as_profile.name: Save as new profile
save_as_profile.description: Stores the current state as a new profile at the end of the list.

values.name: Values
values.description: Store only these values instead of the whole state.

end_temporary.name: End temporary profile
end_temporary.description: Ends a temporary profile started in automatic mode before its time is up. The profile sensor decides again; if it names no profile, nothing is written.

profile_protected.message: The profile "{profile}" is write protected. Turn its write protection off, or save the state as a new profile.

profile_needs_a_name.message: A new profile needs a name.

nothing_to_capture.message: None of the configured entities currently reports a usable value.

profile_name_taken.message: A profile called "{profile}" already exists, or it is the name of the custom profile. Profile names have to be unique.

automatic_mode_on.message: Automatic mode is on, so "{profile}" cannot be chosen by hand. Switch automatic mode off first.

automatic_needs_sensor.message: Automatic mode needs a profile sensor. Set one in the device's options under "Automatic mode".
